summary: Regression test of the backend complexity refactor (auth.py patch_profile/post_onboarding, digest.py _assert_safe_email/_collect, server.py digest_loop). I reviewed the diff against HEAD~1: apart from one minor ordering change (below), the logic is the same. Regression suites (test_python_backend, test_iter5_fixes, test_iter6_limiter, test_account_state) pass: 52 tests, plus test_iter6_limiter 5/5 after I updated one stale test. The send-now test was deselected so no email was sent. test_iter6_limiter::test_pair_limit_per_ip_logic failed at first. The cause was not this refactor: commit c678949 had changed client_ip() to use XFF[-3], and the test still assumed the rightmost hop was the client. I updated the test to the 3-hop chain and it passes. The new test_iter7_refactor.py passes 32/32. It covers: PATCH /users/me (displayName valid/empty/whitespace/65 chars/non-string, 64 chars OK, timezone valid and Mars/Base -> 400, locale truncated to 35, avatar https/data:image/http -> 400/null clears, preferences deep-merge plus invalid theme/time -> 400, {} and all-null -> 400 (root), non-object -> 400, unauth -> 401); onboarding (bad tz -> 400, unknown area -> 400 with lifeAreaNames and completed stays false, valid with and without displayName); digest._collect (overdue sorted, due this week, done/cancelled excluded, active goals, archived habits excluded, None envelope); _assert_safe_email (rejects form, http, bit.ly, mismatched anchor host, 'send your password' in the body and a credential ask in the subject, numeric host; accepts build_email() with and without a plan); claim_digest_week (None for no user/no email/Tuesday/Monday 06:59, claims once and then None); run_digest_pass with send_digest monkeypatched (completes, sends nothing); send_weekly_digest billing error returns False and rolls back last_sent_week. UI smoke as demo: login -> /today; Settings > Profile name change saves (PATCH 200) and survives a reload; restored to 'Demo'. Settings > Notifications Monday briefing toggle: PUT /v1/digest 200, enabled=true, toast shown, survives a reload, toggled back off.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (not 400) when preferences.workingHours or preferences.sleepSchedule is not an object, e.g. {"preferences":{"workingHours":"x"}}. Cause: validate_preferences calls (prefs.get(path[0]) or {}).get(...) on a str. This existed before the refactor.

Returns 500 when lifeAreaNames is not iterable, e.g. 5. Cause: _onboarding_life_areas iterates it without a list check. This existed before the refactor. A string such as 'Work' is iterated char-by-char and gets 400 errors per character, which is odd but not a crash.

A small behaviour change from the refactor: life-area validation now runs after preferences validation (it used to run before). When both are invalid, errors[].field is now preferences.* instead of lifeAreaNames. This is harmless but is not strictly 'no behaviour change'.

issues: The Display name, Timezone, Language and Save changes elements have no data-testid. This is a testability gap; the test had to use labels and roles.
The quiet hours From/Until fields use the browser's native time input instead of a styled picker. Minor.

action_items: LOW: In validate_preferences, check that workingHours and sleepSchedule are dicts and raise invalid(...) instead of a 500.
LOW: In _onboarding_life_areas, require a list of strings and return 400 otherwise.
LOW (optional): Move the _onboarding_life_areas call back before validate_preferences to keep the original error precedence exactly.
LOW: Add data-testid to the Settings Profile inputs and the Save button.
critical_code_review_comments: The refactor is correct: PROFILE_FIELDS handlers, validate_profile_update, apply_user_update, the _check_* helpers, _split_by_due (sort then filter is the same as filter then sort), and claim_digest_week/send_weekly_digest/run_digest_pass all keep the original semantics, including the billing break and rollback.
_timezone stores the raw value but validates str(value). A non-string that happens to be a valid name after str() is unlikely, so this is fine.
patch_profile and post_onboarding call request.json() without handling invalid JSON. A malformed body would 500 for an authenticated user (unauthenticated requests get 401 first).
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users test_rf_*, test_pb_* and test_rl_* (password GoodPass1234!). TEST_digest_* digest_prefs rows were removed in teardown. Demo is restored: displayName 'Demo', digest disabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the regression with --deselect backend/tests/test_python_backend.py::test_mailtest_send_now_once to avoid sending real email. test_iter7_refactor.py imports server/digest directly (sys.path /app/backend) and uses one shared asyncio loop for motor. Settings nav: use main.get_by_text('Notifications', exact=True), because the top-bar bell button has the same name. Settings tab URL: /settings?tab=notifications.
